raw:
@q query
  select ?age
  where match
    relation "be old"
    role subject "the firewall at the branch in Brașov"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "run out"
    role subject "FortiCare"
    role object "the firewall at the branch in Brașov"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
